meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 进行深度安全审计：运行登录检查、OWASP 十大风险检查，扫描硬编码密钥/令牌/连接字符串，审计依赖漏洞，若含 Solidity 则检查智能合约。最后给出“通过/需修改”裁决，生成报告并交给开发代理。
howto.when: 执行 /security-audit（可带路径）时触发；也可用于发布前、代码改动涉及认证/授权/数据处理、添加新依赖等审查时机。未指定范围默认审计整个 src/ 目录。

say.note: 默认检查 src/ 目录并生成报告。
只审计指定路径，不扫描其他目录。

howto.what_en: Deep security audit: SIGN IN checklist, OWASP Top 10, key/token scanning, dependency CVE audit, smart contract checks if Solidity. Outputs verdict and report, hands findings to Dev agent.
howto.when_en: Use before release, after changes to auth/authorization/data handling, or when adding dependencies. Also via /security-audit (with optional paths); defaults to src/ if no scope.

say_en.note: Runs the full audit, defaulting to the src/ directory.
